reviews.review: Incredible combat system. Great visuals. So-so faces, terrible conversation animations. Good RPG, doesnt deserve the hate it got. Still great in 2021, looks amazing in Dolby Vision or HDR on the PC on an OLED.

Great game!! I've played the whole Mass Effect series, and while this isn't like the other games there's still plenty of mass effect-y goodness to love. The main downside was the slightly anticlimactic ending, but the graphics, fun characters, and new lore makes it worth it.
It's fine I guess. Just don't wait anything even remotely near Mass Effect 2 or 3.

After a 634 years nap you wake up in a new galaxy called Andromeda...you have the option to play as a default female or male protagonist (twins) or create your own protagonist..the story is very amazing and unique..a story worth to play..you dont have to play Mass Effect Trilogy in order to understand this..action of game start somewhere in 2185 but all gameplay will be during 2819...once humanity discovered Galaxy and learned about other species and planets of Milky Way together with other species they left the Milky Way to go and explore a new Galaxy Andromeda..after you wake up you will start exploring and your goal will be to make possible the living of humanity and other species in this new galaxy..you will also have few beloved species from Trilogy (if you played it before this) and you will also meet new species if they are friend or foe..that will remain to be seen but remember for them you are the alien..as previous games from franchise you will also have to make choices that will have a small or big impact in your gameplay but since is just one game for now at least most of the choices dont affect the gameplay but in future might be if will ever be Mass Effect Andromeda 2 even not is still awesome to build your own story..gameplay is very good and will also be possible to choose your powers.. in your journey you will discover and learn a lot about the travel in new galaxy of other species or in case you didnt play the trilogy you will also learn a bit of their past history and if you played trilogy you will also hear the voice of one of the most if not the most beloved asari Liara T'Soni and also few mentions of Comander Shephard but their are minor things as the game is focus on a new galaxy and new protagonist...you will also have the option to romance few characters..there are some exclusive for male and some exclusive for female and few for both..and also each of protagonist have their unique relationship where will be shown a bit more than just kissing and than was shown in Trilogy [spoiler] Asari Boobies ❤️ ❤️..if you romance Pelessaria B'Sayle [/spoiler] [spoiler] or better know as Peebee [/spoiler] it will be much more easy to romance characters than previous games because now you will have a big heart on the dialogue that will trigger romance and after 3 times hit that dialogue you will lock the relation and wont be possible romance others so choose carefully..is also possible have at least 2 relationship but isn't worth it because wont be more than few cute dialogues the most worth will be those you will have on your crew..either you play this after trilogy or before you will love the game..is a very unique and awesome game with so many task to do and very enjoying story and with some amazing landscapes on few planets you can visit...there isn't anything rushed thing like in previous games beside few sides missions that are pretty cool that will dissapear if aren't did before the point of no return..missions are easy and short and enjoyable and beside these you can take your time and explore at your free will..have fun and enjoy your time alone or with your beloved one (From game) in this new beautiful and amazing galaxy.
